L001.dl: Over the low sea view and the small wooden vessel. Clear, restrained, sparse. No exact discovery year is implied.
L001.tx: Until the early twelve hundreds, humanity did not know that dragons existed.

L002.dl: Over the sailor and the shape passing beyond the mist. Unhurried.
L002.tx: The seas had names. The kingdoms had borders. Beyond them lay islands no one had reached, and things no one had thought to fear.

L003.dl: Over dissolving landscapes, where the optional place-name captions appear. Name the places plainly; no map is implied.
L003.tx: Tara. Scrapper. Verdor. The Citadel Sea and the Proxy Sea. Seven kingdoms, and undiscovered islands beyond the familiar shores.

L004.dl: The music has entered. Steady, not triumphant.
L004.tx: By the fourteen hundreds, dragons were part of our lives. So were the people who rode them.

L005.dl: Over the dragon's shadow crossing the grass. Last narrator line, just before the title.
L005.tx: This is where our story begins.
